pullRequests.body:
## Summary

- Use one ordered catalog for the homepage and project index. Both now list seven projects and link to the same seven case studies.
- Add Lint Action with a worked complexity-baseline example and a link to the reviewed public README at a pinned revision.
- Expand the rest of the portfolio with project-specific workflow explanations. Keep the planned scopes and private repository boundaries visible.

## Verification

- Before this change, the homepage showed four projects, the index showed six, and three projects had case studies. Playwright now checks that both lists agree and all seven detail routes are reachable.
- `pnpm check`, `pnpm build`, `pnpm test:e2e` and `git diff --check` passed. All 62 Playwright tests passed across desktop and mobile Chromium.
- Inspected generated project HTML and the Lint Action page on desktop in dark mode and mobile in light mode.

## Merge Danger

The change is reversible and affects portfolio content and static project routes.

## Release context

```release-log
version: 1
audience: users
summary: Add Lint Action and expand portfolio project case studies.
impact: The homepage and project index show the same projects, with a detailed write-up for each.
required_action: null
```

## Summary

Exclude the root `CHANGELOG.md` from `oxfmt` so Release Log keeps the exact bytes recorded in its generated proposal. The formatter continues to check authored Markdown.

[Release proposal #25](https://github.com/lhajoosten/lucjoosten.nl/pull/25) depends on this fix reaching `main`. The ordinary merge event lets Release Log refresh that proposal from the new base.

## Verification

- **Before:** `pnpm check` reproduced the Quality failure on the exact merge checkout for #25. `oxfmt` flagged one extra blank line in the generated changelog.
- **After:** `pnpm check`, `pnpm build`, and `pnpm test:e2e` passed with the fix applied to that checkout. All 62 browser tests passed. `git diff --exit-code -- CHANGELOG.md .release-log/inputs.json` confirmed both generated files were unchanged.
- `pnpm check`, `pnpm build`, and `git diff --check` also passed on the fix branch.

## Merge Danger

**Door** — Reversible by reverting the formatter rule.

**Blast radius** — Formatting of the root generated changelog.

## Release context

```release-log
version: 1
audience: internal
summary: Preserve the generated changelog during formatting checks.
impact: Release proposals can pass Quality without rewriting the recorded changelog bytes.
required_action: null
```
